Hey, it's Sunday, uh, October 25th, evening. Just a life update because the move is getting real and I keep forgetting things.

So. The move. We're moving out of the Larkspur Street apartment into the place on Wren Avenue, and the moving date is Saturday November 14th. Wait. No. It's the 21st. I keep saying the 14th because that was the original date before the landlord, Mr. Delacroix, pushed the key handover. It's the 21st. November 21st. Movers are booked, it's the company Two Oaks Moving, they quoted 1,450 dollars for a 4-hour window plus 160 an hour after that. I paid the 200 dollar deposit on Thursday. I have not signed the final contract, they're emailing it.

Okay, the boxes. Ines, my sister, is bringing over like 30 boxes from her office on Wednesday. I packed the bookshelf already, that's 6 boxes, and the kitchen is, um, not started at all. Not at all. The kitchen is going to be the worst part.

Internet. I called the provider and the install at the new place is scheduled for November 23rd between 8 and noon, which means I'll be without internet for two days after the move, unless I can get it moved earlier, which they said probably not. I have to work from the library on the 23rd then, or, hmm, no, the 23rd is a Monday, so yeah, library, or the coffee place on Wren. The coffee place on Wren, by the way, is excellent. I went there after the walkthrough last week and they have this oat cortado, it's so good. Anyway.

Health stuff, the running routine. I've been doing the couch to 10k plan, and this week I did three runs, Tuesday, Thursday, and today. Today was 6.2 kilometers in 38 minutes. I said 6.5 to Ines earlier but I checked the watch, it's 6.2. My left knee was a little sore after, not bad, but I'm, I'm going to skip Tuesday's run if it's still sore, and I didn't book the physio, I keep saying I will. I'll decide Tuesday morning.

Family logistics. Dad's birthday dinner is November 7th, at Ines's place, and I'm supposed to bring dessert. I said I'd bake the lemon tart but honestly with the packing I might just buy one. Haven't decided. Also Mom asked if we can host Thanksgiving at the new place, and I said, um, I said maybe, which she took as yes. That's a problem for future me. We don't even have a dining table, the old one isn't coming with us, I'm selling it. I listed it online for 120 dollars, no offers yet.

Change of address, I did the post office forwarding online, that's done, starts November 20th. I have not updated the address with the bank or my employer yet.

Okay, list for this week: confirm the mover contract, start the kitchen, call about the internet date again, decide on the tart, update the bank. That's it. Goodnight.

Oh, um, also, the car. The registration renewal is due by the end of November, and I need to do it with the new address, so I have to wait until after the forwarding starts, I think, or maybe I can do it now, I don't know, I'll check the website. And the parking at Wren Avenue, the building has a garage spot for 85 a month, which I said I'd take, but I haven't signed that form either. Ugh, so many forms. And, uh, Ines said her partner, Bruno, can help carry the heavy stuff on the 21st in the morning, before the movers come, so we can move the plants and the bike ourselves. The bike definitely is not going in the truck. Okay, I'm going off track. Kitchen. I need to buy packing paper, like, two rolls, for the glasses.
